summary: Iteration 5 UI polish verified on PlanEat mobile web preview (390x844). Register→Planner→tab-navigation→Settings flow all pass. Planner header now correctly exposes week-today (Oggi), duplicate-week-button (icon-only), and open-settings testIDs. Old floating 'Duplica una settimana' bottom CTA is GONE. Spesa header has the new open-settings gear (navigates to /settings). Piatti header regression: open-settings still present. Oggi behavior verified: from initial week '15 ago – 21 ago', tapped week-next twice → '29 ago – 04 set', tapped week-today → snapped back to '15 ago – 21 ago'. Duplicate icon opens duplicate-picker-modal correctly (empty state shown since fresh account had no other planned weeks — expected). Settings screen (Esporta / Ripristina unisci / Ripristina sostituisci / Esci) all render. No deprecated Expo packages surfaced in the reviewed screens. No red-screen or console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: planner.tsx headerIconBtn height is 36px — below the 44px minimum touch target recommendation for the icon-only duplicate-week-button and week-today buttons. Consider bumping to 40–44 to improve tap ergonomics on mobile.
Minor: spesa.tsx open-settings gear button is 36x36 — same tap-target concern as above.

Cosmetic: on planner.tsx, the 'Oggi' pill shows both a calendar icon and text 'Oggi', while duplicate is icon-only and settings is icon-only. The visual weight is slightly inconsistent, but acceptable per iteration spec.
seed_data_creation: Registered fresh throwaway account test<timestamp>@t.co / test1234 via web preview. No dishes or planner data seeded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh register flow uses testID register-submit-button (NOT register-submit). Requires 4 fields: name (optional but works when filled), email, password, password2. After submit ~3.5s to land on planner. Current date during test = Sat 15 Aug 2026 so Planner defaults to week 15 ago – 21 ago (Saturday-anchored). Duplicate modal on a brand-new account shows an empty state — to fully exercise the copy flow, seed at least one prior week via planner-slot before testing duplication.
